animal_identities.cat: lean short-haired grey tabby cat, green eyes
animal_identities.dog: scruffy medium-sized terrier mix, wiry tan-and-grey coat, floppy ears, soulful brown eyes

shots.action: Rain streaks down a dark kitchen window. An empty stainless steel bowl sits on the floor. The terrier mix glances at it, then looks away.
shots.audio: Heavy rain, distant thunder, one low piano note
shots.title: The Bowl

shots.action: The terrier lies by the front door, chin on paws. The grey tabby sits on the windowsill, tail flicking. Both stare at nothing.
shots.audio: Rain continues, soft vinyl crackle, muted trumpet
shots.title: The Suspects

shots.action: The dog drags a single sock across the hallway floor. The cat bats a pencil off a side table and watches it fall.
shots.title: First Offense

shots.action: Unrolled toilet paper trails down the hallway. A cushion lies on the living room floor; the cat stretches beside it. The dog trots past carrying a slipper.
shots.graphics: Full-screen text: GOOD PETS. BAD OPTIONS.
shots.title: The Spree

shots.action: Close on the dog's eyes, then the cat's. Cut back to the empty bowl — still empty.
shots.audio: Music drops to near silence. A single dripping faucet.
shots.title: The Pattern

shots.action: A cardboard box sits on the wet doorstep. A knock. The dog's ears lift. The cat appears at the edge of frame.
shots.audio: Door knock, rain, hopeful acoustic guitar enters
shots.title: The Delivery

shots.action: The open box on the living room rug. Inside: a sturdy stick-shaped chew toy (Durable Training Bite Stick Dog Toy) and a small rolling ball toy (PurrPlay Self-Rolling Cat Toy Ball). The dog noses the chew toy; the cat paws at the ball toy.
shots.camera: Overhead to low angle on the box
shots.graphics: Full-screen text: GOOD PETS. BAD OPTIONS.
shots.title: The Evidence

shots.action: The dog chews contentedly on the stick-shaped chew toy (Durable Training Bite Stick Dog Toy). The cat curls around the rolling ball toy (PurrPlay Self-Rolling Cat Toy Ball), eyes half closed. Sunlight breaks through the window.
shots.graphics: End card: WHO'S A GOOD BOY — whosagoodboypets.myshopify.com
shots.title: Case Closed

locked_lines.opening_narration: Every crime has a motive. Theirs was an empty bowl.
locked_lines.closing_narration: They were never bad. They were just bored. Who's A Good Boy.
